scope: Named-organization deep dossier for Sentinel Advanced Military Solutions, covering Canadian identity, CMP parentage, deployable defence infrastructure, edge manufacturing, modular systems, power, UAS and counter-UAS capabilities.

prospects.name: Sentinel Advanced Military Solutions
prospects.fitSummary: Sentinel AMS is a Canadian defence systems integrator with durable public evidence of deployable infrastructure, edge manufacturing, modular systems, power, and layered UAS and counter-UAS capabilities.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Sentinel's official profile resolves its operating role, mission, CMP Group relationship, and focus on mobile, resilient, self-sustaining defence infrastructure.
The official capability page provides five concrete and separately reviewable system families, including Star Forge, deployable manufacturing, enclosures, power, and counter-UAS.
CADSI's official CANSEC 2026 media kit lists Sentinel Advanced Military Solutions as a new exhibitor and independently corroborates current Canadian defence-sector activity.

prospects.name: Sentinel AMS and CMP Advanced Mechanical Solutions parent relationship
prospects.fitSummary: Sentinel's official profile identifies CMP Group parentage, while CMP's official pages corroborate the Châteauguay operating address and defence-infrastructure manufacturing base.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: CMP's official location page resolves the shared Châteauguay address, Canadian headquarters, public telephone channels, and manufacturing-campus role.

prospects.name: Sentinel AMS CANSEC 2026 participation
prospects.fitSummary: CADSI's official event directory lists Sentinel as a new CANSEC 2026 exhibitor and supports a current Canadian defence-industry membership and participation relationship.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: CADSI's event background explains Canadian operating requirements for exhibitors and corroborates the association relationship recorded inside Sentinel's organization bundle.
